shadows.name: preview
shadows.purpose: Separate the product preview from its stage

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The main action on a workspace surface.
components.css: .primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #1458db); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #1458db); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font: 600 14px system-ui; } .primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #104bbb); } .primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1458db); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: A calm workspace that puts the conversation first
narrative.overview: The homepage introduces Cowork through an example thread and the artifacts it produces. The workspace carries the same outline icons and blue accent into a quieter canvas for daily work.

rules.name: Preview elevation
rules.body: Use the deepest shadow around the example workspace on the homepage.

dos: Keep page titles prominent and action labels concise.
donts: Avoid using the accent for decoration on dense work surfaces.
